lag_value_format.description: Lag values are stored as decimals.

booking_to_invoice.description: Booking-to-invoice linearity represents how booking amount converts into invoices over future weeks.
booking_to_invoice.invoice_within_5_weeks: lag_0 + lag_1 + lag_2 + lag_3 + lag_4 + lag_5
booking_to_invoice.invoice_within_10_weeks: lag_0 + lag_1 + lag_2 + lag_3 + lag_4 + lag_5 + lag_6 + lag_7 + lag_8 + lag_9 + lag_10

invoice_to_cash.description: Invoice-to-cash linearity represents how invoice amount converts into cash collection over future weeks.
invoice_to_cash.collection_within_5_weeks: lag_0 + lag_1 + lag_2 + lag_3 + lag_4 + lag_5
invoice_to_cash.collection_within_10_weeks: lag_0 + lag_1 + lag_2 + lag_3 + lag_4 + lag_5 + lag_6 + lag_7 + lag_8 + lag_9 + lag_10

forecast_rules.forecasted_invoice: Forecasted invoice is the final weekly result generated after applying booking-to-invoice waterfall logic.
forecast_rules.forecasted_collection: Forecasted collection is the final weekly result generated after applying invoice-to-cash waterfall logic.
